subject.title: fix(ai): provider-billed totals desync the cost breakdown and drop cache writes

question: Should `Usage.cost.estimatedTotal` become a supported plugin-SDK contract, or should reconciled estimate provenance remain behind a narrower internal representation?
rationale: The bug fix needs an additional value to preserve both billed and estimated costs, but placing it on the shared `Usage` interface crosses the repository’s guarded plugin API boundary and determines a lasting compatibility promise.

options.title: Adopt the additive SDK field
options.body: Approve `estimatedTotal` as an optional documented companion to provider-billed `total`, then update the guarded API baseline and compatibility coverage.

options.title: Keep the detail internal
options.body: Redesign the propagation so reconciliation metadata does not expand the public shared `Usage` contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt the additive SDK field
recommendation.body: Approve `estimatedTotal` as an optional documented companion to provider-billed `total`, then update the guarded API baseline and compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: A shared AI/plugin-SDK contract owner is needed because the decision affects exported usage semantics rather than only the OpenRouter transport.
